# `aitbc operations governance voting-power`

Get voting power for a blockchain address.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations governance voting-power [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | yes | Blockchain address to fund. |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations governance voting-power --address <address>
```
